notes.title: Update 1.0.44
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.44

This is the first localization patch.  New button added to Main Menu to access language selection.  Three languages added for this build.

Spanish, German and Simplified Chinese.

Any issues then please join the Discord and record the issue in the appropriate channel or start a discussion thread on the community hub.

Thanks
Punto Rojo Studios

notes.title: Whats Coming Soon
notes.content:
Following the graphical updates that have taken much or our time in the past few updates, our next update is to add some localization.  

Soon there will be language options in the menus, the first of which will be Spanish and German and hopefully expand from there.  If you find any inconsistences in these translations then please join the Discord Server and report them in the appropriate channel.  Your help is much appreciated.

Look out for this new option in the coming days.

There has been talk of a fire breathing dragon making an appearance as Soul Skill !!!!

Thanks
Punto Rojo Studios

notes.title: Update 1.0.39 Beta Branch
notes.content:
Version 1.0.39  is now available on the Beta branch on Steam.

List of fixes and updates.

MENU CHANGES

Main Menu

Another visual update to the main menu with scenery and moving camera positions to add more visual interest.  There are still some shadow issues caused by roofing tiles on the housing models.

Options Menu

Shading, View Distance and Foliage sliders added.
Gameplay settings now available to players for some visual effects. ie Rotating build markers can be switched off completely or just stop rotation.

Build Tower Side Menu

Text flickering has been fixed.
Tower targeting drop down added.

Gameplay

Tower Info gizmo added when hovering cursor over a tower, giving Tower Stats to the player.

Targeting now added for each tower allowing priorities to Fastest, Strongest, Weakest, Shielding and Highest Level. This is accessed by clicking on a built tower.

Tower effect volumes adjusted as well as overall sound distance dropoff extended.

Starting the game should now load at your furthest progression.


Select the Beta Branch in Steam game options to try out this update.

notes.title: Rollback of 1.0.39
notes.content: Version 1.0.39 has been rolled back temporarily due to lighting issues.  It will be back as soon as its fixed and working correctly.

notes.title: Update 1.0.39
notes.content:
Update 1.0.39 (08/23/2021)

List of fixes and updates.

[u][b]MENU CHANGES[/b][/u]

[u]Main Menu[/u]

Another visual update to the main menu with scenery and moving camera positions to add more visual interest.

[u]Options Menu[/u]

Shading, View Distance and Foliage sliders added.
Gameplay settings now available to players for some visual effects. ie Rotating build markers can be switched off completely or just stop rotation.

[u]Build Tower Side Menu[/u]

Text flickering has been fixed.
Tower targetting drop down added.

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]

Tower Info gizmo added when hovering cursor over a tower, giving Tower Stats to the player.

Targetting now added for each tower allowing priorities to Fastest, Strongest, Weakest, Shielding and Highest Level. This is accessed by clicking on a built tower. 

Tower effect volumes adjusted as well as overall sound distance dropoff extended.

Shading and shadows on buildings should now be more consistent.

Starting the game should now load at your furthest progression.

notes.title: Coming soon
notes.content:
News update for 26/07/2021

Coming soon to the game are the following features...

Quality settings for Shading, View Distance and Foliage.

A new feature in the Options Menu (GamePlay Settings).  You will be able to switch On and Off different graphical items in the game.  A couple of examples are Monster Health Bars, Stop rotation of Build Symbols and others.

The biggest coming soon item is a skippable mini game that allows you to gain a small upgrade to the Towers you build.  Beware though as failing will grant a small downgrade.  This will also be added to Gameplay settings so that you can always skip(default tower stats are granted) or always risk playing the game to gain a bonus.

I hope these additions will bring further enjoyment to the game.
